results.title: For The Culture Art Installation Unveiled by Forest Forward
results.description: Forest Forward unveiled “For The Culture” art installation, in celebration of South Dallas and the future of the Forest Theater, Aug. 20. The permanent public art installation in Constantin Corner is by acclaimed national public artist, Jessica Bell.
